Package common.hardware.motorcontroller

package common.hardware.motorcontroller
Motors and motor controllers.
  • NAR_TalonFX: a CTRE TalonFX, for Kraken and Falcon motors.
  • NAR_CANSpark: a REV Spark MAX or Spark Flex, for NEO and Vortex motors.
Both are NAR_Motors, so the rest of the code doesn't care which brand a motor is.

You'll rarely call a motor directly: create it, pass it to a mechanism in common.core.subsystems, and let the mechanism configure and drive it.

Simulation

The sim package has physics models for what a motor drives: a roller, something moving in a line, or something pivoting. Mechanisms attach the right one for you, and NAR_Motor.updateSimulation(0.02) in Robot.simulationPeriodic() steps them all. The motor controllers' own simulations then report the simulated position and speed, so robot code reads them exactly as it would on a real robot.
